nodes.title: 工具/基建
nodes.summary: The document outlines several tool and infrastructure projects managed under the 2233admin organization. Each entry names the project, its repository, status (public/private), and a brief description. Highlights include WinForge (Rust-based Windows optimization in issue stage), ai-infra (private infrastructure retrospection), cli-toolkit (public terminal toolset), dev-bootstrap (one-click development environment), claw-proxy (private Rust-based proxy routing), claude-knowledge (private knowledge board with 124 issues), claw-rice (public Claude+OpenClaw configuration pack), and knowledge-graph-engine (public knowledge graph engine).
